title: V3 versus V4 recessed-rib contact sensitivity

gravity_only.title: V3 idealized zero-clearance rigid rail contact
assumptions: Rigid wooden rail, nominal thickness 13 mm; no rail flex or furniture joints modelled
Small-displacement frictionless compression-only contact, zero initial clearance; no adhesion or tensile contact
Surface-node contacts near nominal CAD planes reset to zero initial gap; voxel stair-step offsets are not actual measured clearance
Single X translation gauge, its reaction checked negligible; no fixed Y/Z nodes
Uniform isotropic solid PLA reference E2.06 GPa, not printed infill/layer bonding/creep or load capacity
gravity_only.contact_discretization: Exposed faces pointing toward the wood; full nominal cavity spans, with 0.6 voxel endpoint/plane tolerance; cavity corner nodes may carry two independent normals

v4_voxelization.repeated_face_handling: Count each triangle once; double step on float32 re-hit using cumulative double ray parameter

scope: Direct comparison at the same 2 mm voxel resolution with the same validated small-displacement compression-only contact solver. Each design includes its own solid-model self-weight. User confirmed the 13 mm clip fits nicely; exactly zero clearance and a rigid wooden rail remain idealizations. No print-layer/infill/creep, wood flex, furniture-joint response, failure or load rating is computed.
accuracy: V3 prior 2 to 1.25 mm check changed maximum front 2 kg movement by about 6.2%. V4 has not been independently mesh-refined; numerical ratios are preliminary and should not be presented as certified strength.
